annotation.speech2: A cardioid, the heart-shaped curve r equals 1 plus cosine theta, drawn in blue with its interior shaded light blue. It is symmetric about the x axis, with a cusp at the origin and its widest point at x equals 2. The centroid, at five sixths comma 0, is marked in maroon on the x axis.
The cardioid r equals 1 plus cosine theta, a closed heart-shaped curve with a cusp at the origin, shaded light blue.
The centroid of the cardioid at five sixths comma 0, marked in maroon. It lies on the x axis because the region is symmetric about that axis.
